metadata.name: American Conservatism
metadata.description: The Trump-era Republican programme, with implemented 2025 border and tariff measures used to check its restrictionist and protectionist direction.
metadata.period: United States: 2024 Republican programme, with 2025 executive-order implementation checks
metadata.scope: The 2024 Republican platform as a representative contemporary American conservative variant; January and September 2025 executive acts and independent reporting check implementation in immigration and trade. It is not all American conservatism, a complete incumbent-government assessment or an endorsement of programme factual claims. Revision2 is an incomplete evidence audit of this specified school. Unsupported modern applications and empirical causal comparisons are null/unknown. Neither agreement nor neutrality is inferred from silence. Historical or programme sources are not a complete contemporary incumbent-government record.
metadata.phrase: A society emphasising national sovereignty, border enforcement, private enterprise and traditional institutions under the American constitutional order.

axes.brief: The 2024 Republican programme claims constitutional elections and separated powers; implementation favours assertive executive action.
